"""Close the actual review owners and count saved versus streamed evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V169-balanced-spatial-v3'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);scores=read(root/'scores-v1.json');status=read(root/'status-v1.json')
assert status['status']=='completed-streamed-quality-awaiting-native-render-and-viewing' and status['returned_forwards']==1644
owners=[read(root/'launch-v1.json')['owner'],read(root.parent/'V169-balanced-spatial-v2/launch-v1.json')['owner']]
for owner in owners:
 try:
  p=psutil.Process(owner['pid']);assert p.create_time()!=owner['created'] or p.status() in [psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE,psutil.STATUS_DEAD]
 except psutil.NoSuchProcess:pass
files=list(Path(plan['external']).glob('*/*.npy'));assert len(files)==288
assert sum(p.stat().st_size for p in files)==plan['projected_new_array_bytes']
assert scores['component_forwards']==scores['original_predictions_replayed_exact']==1644
assert scores['new_parent_DINO_forwards']==scores['new_noise_draws']==scores['new_training_updates']==0
save(root/'execution-completion-v1.json',dict(status='complete-two-recorded-review-owners-terminal',owners=owners,actual_quality_neural_roots=1644,
 quality_images=1644,new_parent_roots=0,new_DINO_calls=0,new_training_updates=0,new_source_noise_draws=0,
 original_V168_replays=1644,streamed_method_rows=6576,native_cases=36,new_full_predictions=216,new_direct_correction_arrays=72,
 saved_arrays=288,saved_array_bytes=sum(p.stat().st_size for p in files),new_constant_ADC_outputs_exact_parent=384,
 preparation_admission_failures=1,worker_import_failures_before_neural_work=1,repeated_scientific_forwards=0,
 CUDA_filter_admission_cases=6,CPU_tests=47,new_CPU_tests=19,
 source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),scope=plan['scope']))
print('PASS1644 actual roots;2 review owners terminal;288 saved arrays/.801GiB;no repeated scientific forwards')

"""Build final tables and a native gallery from actual notes and completed scores."""
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V169-balanced-spatial-v3'
assert read(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json')['native_figures']==72
assert read(root/'independent-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
notes=root/'human-quality-notes-v1.md';assert len(notes.read_text())>300
paired=read(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json');summaries={(s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'],s['method']):s for s in paired['summary']}
methods=['parent','V168-raw','V168-EMA','balanced-raw','balanced-EMA','spectral-only-raw','spectral-only-EMA','spatial-only-raw','spatial-only-EMA']
columns=['V143','V168 raw','V168 EMA','Balanced raw','Balanced EMA','Spectral raw','Spectral EMA','Direct raw','Direct EMA']
text='# V169 balanced spatial correction: fixed V168 weights\n\n'+notes.read_text().strip()+'\n\n'
text+='[Final evidence and exact sources](results/v169-balanced-spatial-final-v1.json) · [Native pixel metadata and checkpoints](images/v169-balanced-spatial-v1/manifest-v1.json).\n\n'
cells=[];lines=[]
def table(title,specifications):
 global text
 text+='## '+title+'\n\n| Metric | '+' | '.join(columns)+' |\n| --- | '+' | '.join(['---:']*len(columns))+' |\n'
 for label,kind,condition,cohort,field,digits in specifications:
  values=[]
  for method in methods:
   row=summaries[kind,condition,cohort,method];value=row[field];rendered=f'{value:.{digits}f}'
   cells.append(dict(kind=kind,condition=condition,cohort=cohort,method=method,field=field,digits=digits,rendered=rendered));values.append(rendered)
  line='| '+label+' | '+' | '.join(values)+' |';lines.append(line);text+=line+'\n'
 text+='\n'
table('Mesh response and actual blank error',[
 (label,'mesh',present,None,field,digits) for present in [True,False] for label,field,digits in [
 (('Present' if present else 'Absent')+' full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16',6),
 (('Present' if present else 'Absent')+' signed template gain','template_gain',8),
 (('Present' if present else 'Absent')+' actual blank RMS','blank_error_RMS_DN16',6),
 (('Present' if present else 'Absent')+' blank spatial RMS','blank_spatial_RMS_DN16',6),
 (('Present' if present else 'Absent')+' blank DC RMS','blank_DC_RMS_DN16',6)]])
table('Quiet fields beside edges',[(f'{prior} {label}','mixed-quiet',prior,None,field,6)
 for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('whole RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet RMS','quiet_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet spatial RMS','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('quiet DC RMS','crop_DC_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Standalone native512 flat fields',[(f'{prior} {label}','flat',prior,'fresh-flat512',field,6)
 for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('spatial RMS','full_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Natural photographic detail',[(f'{cohort}/{variant} {label}','photo',variant,cohort,field,6)
 for cohort in ['retained512','organic384'] for variant in ['photo-faint','photo-dark'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band response','crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]])
# Actual cohort/variant names are taken from the frozen design, never inferred from filenames.
design=read(read(root/'plan-v1.json')['design']['path'])
adc_photo=next(c for c in design['observations'] if c.get('cohort')=='adc-photo256')
table('ADC controls',[(f'Photo {label}','photo',adc_photo['variant']['name'],adc_photo['cohort'],field,6) for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]]+
 [(f'Sloped512 {label}','flat','adc-only','adc-sloped512',field,6) for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('spatial RMS','full_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])
text+='All RMS values are camera-RGB DN16. Signed template gain1 means the constructed mesh amplitude; a small signed absent mean is not proof of safety. Coarse32 is spatially centered block-mean error.\n\n'
text+='## Architecture and evidence scope\n\n'
text+='The direct RGB correction is replaced by its Gaussian complement at sigma8/radius24 native pixels, with replicated boundaries and numerical centering for exact constant removal. The parent is not filtered; the spectral path is unchanged. All 47 persistent state tensors and 124,909 weights transfer unchanged from V168. The kernel is fixed and nonpersistent. This is an inference intervention on existing weights, not retraining with a constrained path. Spectral-only and direct-only outputs diagnose the split. References and targets never enter inference. The reused adaptive cohort does not prove blind generalization.\n\n'
text+='All 47 relevant CPU checks pass, including 19 new independent filter/carrier/embedding/gradient tests. Six CPU/CUDA filter value/gradient cases and three FP32 autocast checks pass. Both actual endpoint weights load strictly; all 90 prior neural sources remain unchanged. Original preparation and import failures, sources and receipts are preserved in the [original protocol](results/v169-balanced-spatial-v1/original-protocol-v1.md) and [preparation evidence](results/v169-spatial-balance-preparation-v2.json).\n\n'
text+='A 56GiB local reserve paused the same live review worker before another forward. Seventy owned derived mesh fixtures moved byte-exact to the fast SSD with unchanged original-path links, freeing .752GiB. The worker resumed without repeating completed inference; 56/116GiB local/external guards remain fixed. No original media moved or dataz reads occurred.\n\n'
execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json');audit=read(root/'independent-audit-v1.json')
text+=f"Completed quality work is {execution['actual_quality_neural_roots']:,} actual neural roots, each with exact original V168 replay. All 6,576 method rows have durable journals and input/output fingerprints. Independent Gaussian checks cover {audit['allcase_inprocess_filter_channels']:,} correction channels in process. A separate posthoc audit checks all saved native arrays, {audit['scalar_checks']:,} scalar comparisons and {audit['selected_filter_output_channels_recomputed']:,} selected balanced-output channels. The other new full predictions were not retained; no complete new-array posthoc audit is claimed. Independent Decimal means check {paired['independent_Decimal_mean_checks']:,} reductions. No source/noise, parent/DINO or training calls are added. Both recorded review owners are terminal; the earlier import failure used zero neural calls.\n\n"
text+='## Fixed native comparisons\n\nEvery panel is native160×160 without resizing. Coordinates, camera transform, exposure, contrast and noise conditioning match V168. Main scene DSCF3879/3880 includes sky, building, foliage and coarse fence; cab mesh DSCF3842/3835 includes both priors and camera JPEGs. Separate ISO100/AHD/JPEG views differ in aperture, shutter, motion and processing and are qualitative references, not exact GT. Real captures are not pixelwise scored. Source/ROI, weights, kernel and display metadata are in the manifest. Photographic source credits and licenses remain in the [V168 source report](fine-mesh-training.md#photographic-credits).\n\n'
figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json')
for triplet,title in [(False,'All native comparison boards'),(True,'Noisy, restored, exact constructed GT triplets')]:
 text+='### '+title+'\n\n'
 for item in figures['images']:
  if item['triplet']!=triplet:continue
  name=Path(item['image']['path']).name
  text+=f"{item['case']['id']}; ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`, exposure{item['exposure']:g}, contrast{item['contrast']:g}.\n\n![Native comparison](images/v169-balanced-spatial-v1/{name})\n\n"
text+='[Independent publication verification](results/v169-balanced-spatial-publication-verification-v1.json).\n'
target=repo/'docs/balanced-spatial-correction.md';target.write_text(text)
save(root/'report-bindings-v1.json',dict(status='built-from-actual-notes-and-paired-allcase-tables',report=ref(target),notes=ref(notes),cells=cells,lines=lines,
    source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text())))
print('Built report',len(cells),'rounded metric cells,72 native figures')

"""Publish exact completed evidence and transferred operator checkpoints."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import torch
from demosaic.late_balanced_spatial import LateBalancedSpatialDetail
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V169-balanced-spatial-v3'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
assert read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json')['actual_quality_neural_roots']==1644
assert read(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json')['native_figures']==72
assert read(root/'independent-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
dest=repo/'docs/results/v169-balanced-spatial-v1';images=repo/'docs/images/v169-balanced-spatial-v1';index=repo/'docs/results/v169-balanced-spatial-final-v1.json'
assert not dest.exists() and not images.exists() and not index.exists()
names=['plan-v1.json','scores-v1.json','paired-comparisons-v1.json','independent-audit-v1.json','execution-completion-v1.json',
 'figures-v1.json','native-viewing-completion-v1.json','native-viewing-v1.jsonl','forward-events-v1.jsonl','observations-v1.jsonl',
 'launch-v1.json','status-v1.json','original-protocol-v1.md','human-quality-notes-v1.md','CUDA-filter-admission-v1.json',
 'report-bindings-v1.json','fixture-relocation-v1.json','fixture-relocation-journal-v1.jsonl']
sources={name:root/name for name in names}
sources['initial-preparation-failure.json']=root.parent/'V169-balanced-spatial-v1/preparation-failure-v1.json'
sources['worker-import-failure.json']=root.parent/'V169-balanced-spatial-v2/worker-initialization-failure-v1.json'
sources['worker-import-failure.log']=root.parent/'V169-balanced-spatial-v2/review-v1.log'
assert all(p.is_file() for p in sources.values())
assert shutil.disk_usage(repo).free>56*2**30 and shutil.disk_usage('/mnt/external').free>116*2**30
dest.mkdir();images.mkdir();copies={}
for name,p in sources.items():
 q=dest/name;shutil.copyfile(p,q);assert p.read_bytes()==q.read_bytes();copies[name]=dict(original=ref(p),public=ref(q))
exports={};output=Path(plan['external'])/'exports';output.mkdir()
for endpoint,binding in plan['collections'].items():
 original=read(binding['path']);source=original['export'];assert ref(source['path'])==source
 state=torch.load(source['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
 config=dict(state['module_config'],balance_spatial=True)
 payload=dict(component='LateBalancedSpatialDetail',module_config=config,state_dict=state['state_dict'],parent=state['parent'],
              source_V168_export=source,operator=ref(repo/'src/demosaic/late_balanced_spatial.py'),kernel=plan['kernel'],
              endpoint=endpoint,step=1000,training_updates_for_this_operator=0)
 path=output/f'balanced-{endpoint}-step1000.pt'
 with path.open('xb') as stream:torch.save(payload,stream)
 restored=torch.load(path,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True);module=LateBalancedSpatialDetail(**restored['module_config'])
 module.load_state_dict(restored['state_dict'],strict=True);assert model_hash(module)==original['module_before']
 exports[endpoint]=dict(export=ref(path),source_V168_export=source,module_hash=model_hash(module),module_config=config)
figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json');records=[]
for item in figures['images']:
 p=Path(item['image']['path']);q=images/p.name;shutil.copyfile(p,q);assert p.read_bytes()==q.read_bytes()
 records.append(dict(item,original_image=item['image'],image=ref(q)))
save(images/'manifest-v1.json',dict(images=records,checkpoints=exports,operator=ref(repo/'src/demosaic/late_balanced_spatial.py'),kernel=plan['kernel'],
    source=ref(root/'figures-v1.json'),native_figures=72,native_triplets=24,no_resize=True))
helpers=[repo/'.cache'/name for name in ['reduce-v169-balanced-v1.py','audit-v169-balanced-v1.py','record-v169-viewing-v1.py',
    'finish-v169-execution-v1.py','build-v169-report-v1.py','publish-v169-balanced-v1.py','verify-v169-publication-v1.py']]
helpers += [Path(b['path']) for b in plan['metrics_sources']]
save(dest/'source-bundle-v1.json',dict(preparation=ref(repo/'docs/results/v169-spatial-balance-preparation-v2.json'),
    additional_sources=[dict(ref(p),text=p.read_text()) for p in helpers],
    fixture_relocation_source=read(root/'fixture-relocation-v1.json')['source']))
save(index,dict(status='completed-fixed-weight-intervention-audited-and-actually-viewed',preparation=ref(repo/'docs/results/v169-spatial-balance-preparation-v2.json'),
    initial_preparation=ref(repo/'docs/results/v169-spatial-balance-preparation-v1.json'),postprocess_preparation=ref(repo/'docs/results/v169-postprocess-preparation-v1.json'),
    copies=copies,sources=ref(dest/'source-bundle-v1.json'),figures=ref(images/'manifest-v1.json'),report=ref(repo/'docs/balanced-spatial-correction.md'),
    checkpoints=exports,actual_neural_roots=1644,exact_original_prediction_replays=1644,streamed_method_rows=6576,
    saved_new_full_predictions=216,saved_direct_correction_arrays=72,native_cases=36,native_figures=72,native_triplets=24,
    new_parent_DINO_forwards=0,new_noise_draws=0,new_training_updates=0,prior_neural_files_unchanged=90,new_neural_modules=1,
    CPU_tests=47,new_CPU_tests=19,CUDA_filter_checks=6,strict_transferred_endpoint_loads=2,scope=plan['scope']))
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
print('Published',len(copies),'exact receipts,72 native PNGs,2 fixed-operator checkpoints;no forwards')

"""Check exact publication copies, source bindings, tables, native pixels and links."""
import re,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from demosaic.late_balanced_spatial import LateBalancedSpatialDetail
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V169-balanced-spatial-v3'
output=repo/'docs/results/v169-balanced-spatial-publication-verification-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
index=repo/'docs/results/v169-balanced-spatial-final-v1.json';final=read(index);prep=read(final['preparation']['path']);plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
assert ref(final['preparation']['path'])==final['preparation'] and len(final['copies'])==21
for copies in final['copies'].values():
 assert ref(copies['original']['path'])==copies['original'] and ref(copies['public']['path'])==copies['public']
 assert Path(copies['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(copies['public']['path']).read_bytes()
sources=read(final['sources']['path']);assert len(sources['additional_sources'])==9
for source in prep['source_texts']+sources['additional_sources']+[sources['fixture_relocation_source'],prep['publisher']]:
 assert ref(source['path'])['sha256']==source['sha256'] and Path(source['path']).read_text()==source['text']
for path,h in prep['prior_neural_sources_unchanged'].items():assert ref(path)['sha256']==h
assert len(prep['prior_neural_sources_unchanged'])==90 and prep['CPU_checks']==47
for endpoint,binding in final['checkpoints'].items():
 assert ref(binding['export']['path'])==binding['export']
 state=torch.load(binding['export']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
 module=LateBalancedSpatialDetail(**state['module_config']);module.load_state_dict(state['state_dict'],strict=True)
 assert model_hash(module)==binding['module_hash'] and state['source_V168_export']==binding['source_V168_export']
 assert state['kernel']==plan['kernel'] and state['training_updates_for_this_operator']==0
 assert ref(state['operator']['path'])==state['operator']
paired=read(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json');summary={(s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'],s['method']):s for s in paired['summary']}
bindings=read(root/'report-bindings-v1.json');report=repo/'docs/balanced-spatial-correction.md';text=report.read_text()
assert ref(report)==bindings['report']==final['report']
for cell in bindings['cells']:
 s=summary[cell['kind'],cell['condition'],cell['cohort'],cell['method']];assert f"{s[cell['field']]:.{cell['digits']}f}"==cell['rendered']
for line in bindings['lines']:assert line in text
native=read(final['figures']['path']);assert len(native['images'])==72 and sum(i['triplet'] for i in native['images'])==24
new_channels=copied_channels=0
prior=read(plan['prior_figures']['path'])
for item,old in zip(native['images'],prior['images'],strict=True):
 assert ref(item['image']['path'])==item['image'] and item['source_figure']==old['image'] and item['no_resize']
 assert Path(item['image']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['original_image']['path']).read_bytes()
 assert item['ROI_xywh']==old['ROI_xywh'] and item['anchor']==old['anchor'] and item['contrast']==old['contrast'] and item['exposure']==old['exposure']
 image=np.asarray(__import__('PIL.Image',fromlist=['Image']).open(item['image']['path']))
 old_image=np.asarray(__import__('PIL.Image',fromlist=['Image']).open(old['image']['path']))
 a=dict(np.load(item['case']['arrays']['path']));anchor=np.asarray(item['anchor']).reshape(1,3,1,1)
 old_panels={p['label']:p for p in old['panels']}
 for panel in item['panels']:
  name=panel['label'];x,y,w,h=panel['xywh'];assert w==h==160
  if name in item['predictions']:
   b=item['predictions'][name];assert ref(b['path'])==b
   value=np.load(b['path']);expected=independent_display(anchor+item['contrast']*(value.astype(np.float64)-anchor),a,item['ROI_xywh'],item['exposure']);new_channels+=expected.size
  else:
   label={'V168 raw':'Fine mesh raw1k','V168 EMA':'Fine mesh EMA1k'}.get(name,name)
   source=old_panels[label];ox,oy,ow,oh=source['xywh'];expected=old_image[oy:oy+oh,ox:ox+ow];copied_channels+=expected.size
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y:y+h,x:x+w],expected)
view=read(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json');assert view['native_figures']==72 and sorted(view['indices'])==list(range(72))
assert ref(view['journal']['path'])==view['journal']
execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json');assert execution['actual_quality_neural_roots']==1644 and execution['repeated_scientific_forwards']==0
audit=read(root/'independent-audit-v1.json');assert audit['original_replays_checked']==1644 and audit['saved_native_predictions_checked']==288 and audit['saved_direct_corrections_checked']==72
diary=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();assert diary.is_relative_to(repo/'diary') and diary.is_file()
documents=[repo/p for p in ['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md','docs/balanced-spatial-correction.md']]+[diary]
links=0
for p in documents:
 for target in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
  if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):continue
  resolved=(p.parent/target.split('#')[0]).resolve();assert resolved==output or resolved.is_file(),(p,target);links+=1
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
save(output,dict(status='pass-exact-copies-sources-tables-native-pixels-and-links',publication=ref(index),exact_copies=21,source_texts_checked=len(prep['source_texts'])+11,
    unchanged_prior_neural_files=90,strict_checkpoint_loads=2,rounded_table_cells=len(bindings['cells']),native_figures=72,native_triplets=24,
    new_RGB_channels_recomputed=new_channels,unchanged_RGB_channels_compared=copied_channels,document_links_checked=links,
    documents={str(p):ref(p) for p in documents},new_neural_forwards=0,new_noise_draws=0,CUDA_initialized=False,
    source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    scope='Publication,all saved native pixels and table means checked. Scientific score/replay/input scope is exactly the separate audit:1644 original replay bindings and all6576 durable rows;posthoc new-array recomputation covers the36 saved native cases,not all822 new full predictions. No broader claim is made.'))
print('PASS21 exact copies;',len(bindings['cells']),'rounded cells;72 native images;',new_channels+copied_channels,'channels;',links,'links')
